usage.callShape: GET https://stablefinance.dev/api/earnings?ticker=AAPL&limit=4 (x402, no body). Method is GET with query params, NOT POST.
usage.outputShape: body.earnings[] — each item: ticker, report_period (YYYY-MM-DD), fiscal_period (e.g. FY2025), source_type (e.g. 10-K), filing_date, filing_window (e.g. AFTER_HOURS), filing_url (SEC EDGAR link)
quirks: Method is GET with query params, NOT POST. The registry surface may label it POST; use GET. Inputs go as URL query params, not a JSON body.

ticker query param is OPTIONAL — omit it for the cross-ticker (most-recent-across-all) earnings feed; include it (e.g. ?ticker=AAPL) for a single company. limit is an integer 1-100. additionalProperties is false (only ticker and limit are accepted).
x402 flat $0.02/call (amount 20000 @ 6 decimals). Accepts Base USDC (eip155:8453, payTo 0xBD17480bf6ff056f7b91d9AdC9DfDa001eb7283D) and Solana USDC. No API key.
Output is nested under body.earnings (array of filing objects), not a flat list. filing_url points to the SEC EDGAR filing.

ENVIRONMENT-ONLY: this QA host's OS DNS cannot resolve stablefinance.dev (ENOTFOUND); public DNS resolves it to 216.150.16.193. The current qa-pay.mjs dist lacks the dns.lookup patch, so the money-safe pay tool's fetch failed pre-payment (no money lost). A normal agent on normal DNS is unaffected. NO fresh paid call was executed in this environment; payability + exact schema were confirmed via a direct 402 probe to the known IP and the server's own x402 bazaar extension.
Same x402 backend (StableFinance / Financial Datasets AI) as the /api/financials route which was previously paid+verified.
usage.guide: Call as a GET (not POST) at https://stablefinance.dev/api/earnings with optional query params: ticker (a US-equity symbol like AAPL) and limit (1-100). Include ?ticker=AAPL for one company's most-recent earnings filings, or omit ticker for the cross-ticker feed. It is an x402 endpoint, flat $0.02/call on Base USDC (also Solana), no API key. Read results from body.earnings — an array of objects with ticker, report_period, fiscal_period, source_type (10-K/10-Q), filing_date, filing_window, and filing_url (SEC EDGAR). Do NOT POST.
